definitions.short: Lemek , the name of two antediluvian patriarchs
definitions.full: H3929. Lemek לֶ֫מֶךְ proper name, masculine (on original form compare Lag BN 77 ; conjecture as to meaning Bu Urgesch. 102, 129 ); — ׳ל Gen 4:19 7 t.; לָ֑מֶךְ 4:18 2 t.; — 1 son of מְתוּשָׁאֵל (Cainite) Gen 4:18-19 , 23 (twice in verse); 4:24 (all J). 2 son of מְתוּשֶׁלַח (Sethite) Gen 5:25-26 , 28 , 30 , 31 (all P), 1Chr 1:3 . — ᵐ5 Ααμεχ . לְמִנִּי לְמִן, see מִן 9b. לְמַעַן see מען below ענה . לֹעַ see below I. לוּעַ .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root of uncertain meaning;
